Root check 148_scan015-CHECK-tetrahedral-counts. The written counts 4 vertices, 12 edges and 8 faces have alternating sum 4-12+8=0. For an explicitly defined combinatorial tetrahedron, take vertices 0,1,2,3 and the oriented boundary faces (1,2,3), (0,3,2), (0,1,3), (0,2,1), with cyclic rotations identifying each face orientation. Enumeration of all 24 vertex permutations gives twelve preserving these four oriented faces. Exactly three fix vertex 0: the identity, sigma=(1 2 3), and sigma squared. All 36 products of the map from residues k modulo 6 to sigma^k were checked. Its kernel is {0,3}, and its three fibers are {0,3}, {1,4}, {2,5}; sending these fibers to 0,1,2 modulo 3 gives the explicit cyclic quotient. The earlier matrix check on scan 011 gave J^3=-I for the written minus-conjugate generator, providing the corresponding central order-two element in the displayed base action. The tetrahedral model has 4 vertices, 6 edges and 4 faces, with alternating sum 2. These computations check the finite combinatorial group and the stated counts; the scan still decides the overwritten numeral and every source letter. The geometric identification of the drawn quotient was read as a source statement, not proved by the alternating sums.
